sections.intro: At OpenSense Labs, I worked on consent-aware tracking, customer segmentation, personalization, automation and an early RAG proof of concept.

sections.label: THE THREAD
sections.heading: Useful personalization starts with consent.
sections.lead: I helped build features that used customer data according to consent and regional privacy requirements.
points: I implemented consent-aware tracking and customer segmentation workflows with Apache Unomi.
I also developed backend personalization and automation features and explored retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

items.title: Finding useful context in a knowledge base.
items.description: Built a RAG proof of concept using Node.js, Python, OpenAI embeddings, Pinecone and GPT-3.5-turbo. It covered chunking, vector search, KNN retrieval, cosine similarity and contextual retrieval.

sections.label: AFTER HOURS
sections.heading: A job scheduler I built outside work.
sections.lead: A small, interactive view of a separate side project.
sections.description: The scheduler uses Redis queues and PostgreSQL job state. It supports scheduled jobs, concurrent workers, retries, idempotency and failure recovery.
